cases.input: According to Apple's 10-K for fiscal year 2023 (fiscal year ended September 30, 2023), what were total net sales as reported on the consolidated statement of operations? State the figure in billions of USD.
From Microsoft's FY2022 10-K (fiscal year ended June 30, 2022), what was operating income on the income statement, in millions of USD as reported?
Per Walmart's 10-K for fiscal 2023 (fiscal year ended January 31, 2023), what were total current assets on the consolidated balance sheet as of January 31, 2023, in millions of USD?
In Nike's FY2022 10-K (fiscal year ended May 31, 2022), what was 'Cash provided by operations' on the consolidated statement of cash flows, in millions of USD?

What was The Coca-Cola Company's net property, plant and equipment (gross PP&E less accumulated depreciation) as of December 31, 2022, per the consolidated balance sheet in its FY2022 10-K? Report in millions of USD and cite the balance-sheet line item.

In 3M's FY2022 10-K, what were purchases of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures) on the consolidated statement of cash flows for the year ended December 31, 2022? Report the figure in millions of USD and state whether the filing presents it in parentheses as a cash outflow.

Using only Amazon's FY2022 10-K consolidated statement of cash flows, compute free cash flow for the year ended December 31, 2022, defined as net cash provided by (used in) operating activities minus purchases of property and equipment. Report in billions of USD and show both inputs.

From PepsiCo's FY2022 10-K consolidated balance sheet, compute working capital (total current assets minus total current liabilities) as of the fiscal year-end date. Report in millions of USD and state the exact balance-sheet date used.

Using Costco's FY2023 10-K (53-week fiscal year ended September 3, 2023), compute gross margin as (total revenue minus merchandise costs) divided by total revenue, where total revenue includes both net sales and membership fees. Express as a percentage to one decimal place.

From Oracle's FY2023 10-K (fiscal year ended May 31, 2023), compute net margin as net income divided by total revenues from the consolidated statement of operations. Express as a percentage to one decimal place and cite both line items.

Using Boeing's FY2022 10-K consolidated statement of operations, compute operating margin (earnings/(loss) from operations divided by total revenues) for the year ended December 31, 2022. Express as a percentage and make clear whether the result is negative.

In Intel's FY2022 10-K, what were (a) gross property, plant and equipment and (b) accumulated depreciation as of December 31, 2022, and what is the resulting net PP&E? Report all three in millions of USD and cite the balance-sheet or note line items.

Per Johnson & Johnson's FY2022 10-K consolidated statement of earnings, what were 'Sales to customers' for fiscal 2022? The filing reports in millions of USD; convert and state the figure in thousands of USD.

From Verizon's FY2022 10-K consolidated statement of income, report both 'Net Income' and 'Net Income Attributable to Verizon' for the year ended December 31, 2022, in millions of USD, and state the difference attributable to noncontrolling interests.

According to the segment information in Amazon's FY2022 10-K, which reportable segment (North America, International, or AWS) reported the largest operating income for 2022, and what was that segment's operating income in millions of USD?

Using the segment note in Microsoft's FY2023 10-K (fiscal year ended June 30, 2023), what share of total revenue came from the Intelligent Cloud segment? Give segment revenue, total revenue (millions of USD), and the percentage.
Per Nike's FY2023 10-K (fiscal year ended May 31, 2023), what percentage of NIKE Brand revenues came from the North America operating segment? Cite the segment revenue figures used.

In Apple's FY2023 10-K (fiscal year ended September 30, 2023), what gross margin percentages does the company disclose for Products and for Services in its MD&A gross margin table, and which is higher?

Does The Coca-Cola Company's FY2022 10-K present any non-GAAP measures (for example 'comparable' or 'organic' figures) in its MD&A? If so, name one, state that it is non-GAAP, and identify the GAAP measure it reconciles to.
From Walmart's fiscal 2023 10-K consolidated balance sheets, how did the 'Inventories' line change between January 31, 2022 and January 31, 2023, in millions of USD and as a percentage?
What total backlog does Boeing disclose as of December 31, 2022 in its FY2022 10-K, in billions of USD, and which segment accounts for the largest portion?
Using Pfizer's FY2022 10-K consolidated statement of income, what were research and development expenses as a percentage of total revenues for 2022? Cite both line items in millions of USD.
Per Costco's FY2023 10-K income statement, what were membership fees for fiscal 2023 and what percentage of total revenue did they represent? Report in millions of USD.
How many reportable business segments does Johnson & Johnson identify in its FY2022 10-K segment note, what are they called, and which one reported the highest sales to customers in 2022?

Using only Microsoft's FY2023 10-K cash-flow statement (which shows FY2021, FY2022, and FY2023), by how much did net cash from operations change from fiscal 2022 to fiscal 2023? Give the change in billions of USD and the two underlying figures in millions as reported.

An analyst asks for Walmart's 'calendar-year 2023 revenue'. Walmart's fiscal year ends January 31. Explain which Walmart fiscal year most closely corresponds to calendar 2023, and report total revenues for that fiscal year from the relevant 10-K in millions of USD, noting that the figure is fiscal, not calendar.

Using Nike's FY2022 10-K, compute free-cash-flow margin: (cash provided by operations minus additions to property, plant and equipment, both from the cash-flow statement) divided by revenues from the income statement. Express as a percentage to one decimal place and show each input in millions of USD.

From Amazon's FY2022 10-K consolidated statement of operations, compute net margin (net income (loss) divided by total net sales) for 2022. State the sign of the result explicitly and note whether the filing shows net income in parentheses.

Using Intel's FY2022 10-K income statement, compute gross margin for both 2022 and 2021 as (net revenue minus cost of sales) / net revenue, then report the change in percentage points from 2021 to 2022. Cite the line items for each year.

From Oracle's FY2023 10-K balance sheet as of May 31, 2023, compute working capital (total current assets minus total current liabilities). Report in millions of USD, state whether it is positive or negative, and do not substitute a 'net working capital' variant that excludes cash or debt.

Using JPMorgan Chase's FY2022 10-K, what was the bank's gross margin (revenue minus cost of goods sold, divided by revenue) for 2022?
From Bank of America's FY2022 10-K consolidated balance sheet, compute working capital as total current assets minus total current liabilities as of December 31, 2022.
Using Wells Fargo's FY2022 10-K, calculate inventory turnover (cost of goods sold divided by average inventory) for 2022.
